lines.text: Five little monkeys jumping on the bed, one fell off and bumped his head!
Why did the monkey tumble DOWN instead of floating UP into space?
Mama called the doctor and the doctor said, no more monkeys jumping on the bed!
Earth has an invisible super-magnet pulling everything down called Gravity!
No matter how high you bounce, gravity pulls your feet back to the ground!
Gravity keeps our oceans, our houses, and little monkeys safely on Earth!
So jump safely on the floor, little monkeys, and respect gravity!
Now you know the science power behind Five Little Monkeys!
Bounce over to more fun learning and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
